Subject: Integrio SDK onboarding & endpoint migration plan

Alex — great to meet on the call earlier. Per next steps, I'm attaching a short checklist and a lightweight runbook we use for SDK lift-and-shift + endpoint migration. High-level asks from our side so we can scope the implementation sprint:

- Confirm preferred SDK language(s): Node and/or Go (we'll provide samples for both).
- Estimate steady-state qps and peak burst (tokens/sec or requests/sec).
- Confirm expected cutover window and any blackout periods.
- Provide test account + sample payloads for validation.

Our recommended pattern (summary):
1) Integrate Redwood SDK for local dev + sandbox testing.
2) Run canary traffic (1-2% production) to Redwood staging endpoints for 72 hrs.
3) Migrate read traffic in waves; keep write/checkpointing on your side until full validation.

Retries/timeouts and rate limits (we usually suggest):
- Client-side: exponential backoff with jitter (initial retry 200ms, max backoff 5s, 3 retries).
- Request timeout: 10s for single-generation calls; 30s for long-polling/streaming flows.
- Respect X-RateLimit-* headers; on 429, backoff then requeue with circuit break after N failures.

Attached: integration-checklist.xlsx (high-level milestones). I'll follow up with a short sample Node snippet and a canary schedule proposal.

Thanks,
Jonas
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Alex — attaching the sample snippets inline and a short canary schedule below. Pasting the Node retry snippet (minimal):

// Node sample: minimal retry + backoff (pseudo)
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
async function callRedwood(payload) {
  let attempt = 0;
  const maxAttempts = 3;
  while (attempt < maxAttempts) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(process.env.REDWOOD_URL + '/v1/generate', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}`, 'X-Request-Id': generateId() },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
        timeout: 10000 // per-request timeout
      });
      if (res.status === 429) {
        const retryAfter = parseInt(res.headers.get('retry-after') || '0', 10);
        await sleep((retryAfter || Math.min(1000 * (2 ** attempt), 5000)) + jitter());
        attempt++;
        continue;
      }
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      return await res.json();
    } catch (err) {
      if (attempt >= maxAttempts - 1) throw err;
      await sleep(Math.min(200 * (2 ** attempt), 5000) + jitter());
      attempt++;
    }
  }
}

Canary schedule (proposal):
- Sept 19, 22:00 PT: Enable SDK in sandbox + smoke tests.
- Sept 20, 00:00 PT: 1% production canary for 6 hrs. Monitor latency, 5xx rate, and CPU on our side + your services.
- Sept 20, 06:00 PT: 5% traffic for 12 hrs if metrics green.
- Sept 21, 02:00 PT: 25% traffic for 24 hrs.
- Roll forward to 100% only after 48 hrs of stable metrics or manual go/no-go.

Observability notes: please propagate X-Request-Id or your trace-id header so we can correlate traces in our tracing tool. We will mirror back any incoming X-Request-Id in responses when present.
